text: Planning a trip can be exciting, but it also takes time and effort. You need to choose a destination, book tickets, and pack your bags. When you travel, you meet new cultures and try delicious local food. However, language barriers can sometimes make things difficult, so it helps to learn a few basic words. Despite small problems, travel gives you unforgettable memories that stay with you forever. For example, I once got lost in a busy market, but a kind stranger helped me find my way back. That moment taught me that travel is not just about seeing new places, but also about connecting with people.
